description: This file declares functions related to I/O operations and utility functions for the at91 platform, including UART initialization, string operations, and formatted printing.

methods.name: at91_init_uarts
methods.description: Initializes UART devices for the at91 platform.

methods.name: puts
methods.description: Outputs a string to standard output.

methods.name: putchar
methods.description: Outputs a single character, possibly same as putc.

methods.name: strlen
methods.description: Computes the length of a string.

methods.name: hvfprintf
methods.description: Outputs formatted data according to a format string and argument list.

methods.name: printf
methods.description: Prints formatted data to standard output.
